note: EVAL wording. Each family gives an ADD and a SUB question over the same two numbers x (written first) and y. ADD gold = x+y. SUB gold = x-y with x>y.

families.add: In the garden, {name} planted {x} {noun} along the fence and {y} {noun} by the gate. What is the total number of {noun} {name} planted?
families.sub: In the garden, {name} planted {x} {noun} along the fence and {y} {noun} by the gate. What is the difference between the number planted along the fence and the number planted by the gate?

families.add: A bus carried {x} {noun} in its front section and {y} {noun} in its back section. How many {noun} were on the bus in total?
families.sub: A bus carried {x} {noun} in its front section and {y} {noun} in its back section. How many fewer {noun} were in the back section than in the front section?

families.add: At the bake sale, {name} sold {x} {noun} before lunch and {y} {noun} after lunch. How many {noun} did {name} sell during the whole day?
families.sub: At the bake sale, {name} sold {x} {noun} before lunch and {y} {noun} after lunch. How many more {noun} were sold before lunch than after lunch?

families.add: {name} has {x} {noun} due back at the library, and {name2} has {y} {noun} due back. How many {noun} are due back from the two of them combined?
families.sub: {name} has {x} {noun} due back at the library, and {name2} has {y} {noun} due back. How many fewer {noun} does {name2} have due than {name}?

families.add: {name} won {x} {noun} in round one of a game and {y} {noun} in round two. How many {noun} did {name} win over both rounds?
families.sub: {name} won {x} {noun} in round one of a game and {y} {noun} in round two. What is the difference between the number won in round one and the number won in round two?

families.add: For a weekend trip, {name} brought {x} {noun} and {name2} brought {y} {noun}. How many {noun} did they bring altogether?
families.sub: For a weekend trip, {name} brought {x} {noun} and {name2} brought {y} {noun}. How many more {noun} did {name} bring than {name2}?
